[[Eurocup Basketball|Eurocup]] | team = Cedevita Zagreb | team_link = KK Cedevita | number = 23 | ethnicity = [[Bosniak]] | nationality = Bosnian | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1994|8|23|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Živinice]], [[Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] | college = | draft = | draft_year = | career_start = 2012 | career_end = | years1 = 2010-2012 | team1 = [[KK Zlatorog Laško|Zlatorog Laško]] (Slovenia) | years2 = 2012 | team2 = → [[KK Union Olimpija|Union Olimpija]] (Slovenia) | years3 = 2012–present | team3 = [[KK Cedevita|Cedevita Zagreb]] (Croatia) | years4 = 2013 | team4 = → [[KK Zadar|Zadar]] (Croatia) | highlights = * [[A-1 Liga|A-1 Liga champion]] ([[2013–14 A-1 League|2014]]) * 2× [[Krešimir Ćosić Cup|Croatian Cup]] (2012, 2014) }} '''Jusuf Nurkić''' (born 23 August 1994) is a Bosnian professional [[basketball]] player who currently plays for [[KK Cedevita|Cedevita]] of the [[A-1 Liga|Croatian League]]. He is a 6'11" (2.11 m) tall [[Center (basketball)|center]] and weights 280 lb (127 kg). He is also a member of the [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national basketball team]]. He is considered one of the top prospects for the [[2014 NBA Draft]]. ==Early career== Nurkić played for more than two seasons with the Slovenian team [[KK Zlatorog Laško|Zlatorog Laško]] at the junior level. In February 2012, he was briefly loaned to [[KK Union Olimpija|Union Olimpija]] in order to play the [[Euroleague Basketball|Euroleague]] [[Euroleague Basketball Nike International Junior Tournament|NIJT]] which was held in Belgrade. That was the first bigger notice he putted on his name, averaging 18.8 points and 11 rebounds over 5 games.{{cite web|last=Petrinović|first=Igor|title=Jusuf Nurkic, Cedevita Zagreb|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/features/player-spotlight/i/130110/3737/jusuf-nurkic-cedevita-zagreb|work=eurocupbasketball.com|accessdate=25 March 2014}}{{cite web|title=Nurkic Jusuf stats NIJT|url=http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=004053&seasoncode=JT11|work=euroleague.net|accessdate=25 March 2014}} Shortly after return from the tournament, he parted ways with Zlatorog Laško by the end of February.{{cite web|last=Perko|first=Darko|title=Nadarjeni Jusuf Nurkić zapušča vrste Zlatoroga; kam odhaja, še ni znano|url=http://kosarka.si/jusuf-nurkic-zapusca-vrste-zlatoroga-kam-odhaja-se-ni-znano/|work=kosarka.si|accessdate=25 March 2014}}{{sl icon}} Few days after it was revealed that he is training with Croatian team [[KK Cedevita|Cedevita]].{{cite web|title=The Lasko suspended Yusuf Nurkić is moving to Cedevito|url=http://kosarka.si/v-laskem-suspendirani-jusuf-nurkic-prestopil-v-cedevito/|work=kosarka.si|accessdate=25 March 2014}}{{sl icon}} ==Professional career== ===Cedevita Zagreb (2012-present)=== In October 2012, after few months of training with the Croatian team [[KK Cedevita|Cedevita]], Nurkić signed a four-year plus one contract with them.{{cite web|last=Vrbanić|first=Tomislav|title=Jusuf Nurkić i službeno u Cedeviti|url=http://crosarka.com/hrvatska-muska-kosarka/cedevita/jusuf-nurkic-i-sluzbeno-u-cedeviti-2487|work=crosarka.com|accessdate=25 March 2014}}{{hr icon}}{{cite web|title=Nurkiću se ostvaruju snovi|url=http://balkans.aljazeera.net/vijesti/nurkicu-se-ostvaruju-snovi|work=balkans.aljazeera.net|accessdate=25 March 2014}}{{hr icon}} After signing his contract, in the press-conference he has given reason why he parted ways with [[Zlatorog Laško]], accusing his former coach Miloš Šporar for not giving him chance to play.{{cite web|last=Kontić|first=A.|title=Nurkić: Napokon! Jedva čekam prvi nastup za Cedevitu|url=http://sportsport.ba/bh_kosarka/nurkic-napokon-jedva-cekam-prvi-nastup-za-cedevitu/89576|work=sportsport.ba|accessdate=25 March 2014}}{{hr icon}} In his first season with Cedevita, he had small role in the team under head coach [[Aleksandar Petrović (basketball)|Aleksandar Petrović]], mostly playing in the garbage time. In the [[2012-13 Euroleague|Euroleague]], he has played only 6 games, averaging 1.8 points per game. In the January 2013 Nurkić was loaned to [[KK Zadar|Zadar]] until the end of season on his initiative, willing to play more minutes.{{cite web|last=Jurišić|first=Bernard|title=hrsport.net|url=http://www.hrsport.net/vijesti/453466/kosarka-aba-liga/jusuf-nurkic-na-posudbi-u-zadru-trazi-se-travis/|work=Jusuf Nurkić na posudbi u Zadru, traži se Travis|accessdate=25 March 2014}}{{hr icon}} In the second season, under new head coach [[Jasmin Repeša]] he has made breakthroughs in the regional [[ABA Liga|Adriatic League]], averaging 11.6 points and 5.6 rebounds per game, although for only 16.3 minutes spent onto the court, mainly because of foul troubles and conditioning issues.{{cite web|last=Schmitz|first=Mike|title=Nurkic Making Noise in the Adriatic League|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/article/Nurkic-Making-Noise-in-the-Adriatic-League-4373/|work=draftexpress.com|accessdate=25 March 2014}} ==Euroleague career statistics==
